configuration.candidate_selection: Validation completed count, then duration coverage; full-set economic cost when all complete

training_td_fit.scope: actual optimizer minibatch draws before Adam; count includes repeat draws
training_td_fit.prefix_label_note: A streaming prefix remains normal_nonterminal until its voyage fails; historical draws retain their label at draw time.

checkpoint_replay_fit.scope: read-only stratified replay diagnostic; measured_count is not the replay population or actual optimizer draws
checkpoint_replay_fit.sampling: up to 8192 distinct entries per class; entire class when at most 8192
checkpoint_replay_fit.p95_note: P95 is exact for the saved diagnostic sample; it is not asserted to be the full-replay P95.

train_failure_value.interpretation: Only actual Train transitions; read-only checkpoint inference. Observed return is the realized epsilon-greedy trajectory return, not Q* or a counterfactual benefit. TD targets use current target-network masked max; they are moving learning targets. The first upper/lower failures are fixed for checkpoint comparisons; no report rows enter Replay.
